app_info.subtitle: Run adaptive A/B tests
app_info.description: LiveVariant helps users create adaptive A/B tests for email and web, inspect test links, warm-start tests with priors, upload image variants, register tests to an account, and read results with win probabilities and domain/account status.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a fresh test config and can register it to an organization when a publishable key is supplied.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or write to third-party systems; account registration stays within LiveVariant.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only decodes a supplied LiveVariant config or URL and reports its structure and findings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact external services or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a new encoded config with priors and returns it without writing server state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact external services or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches test statistics from LiveVariant and derives win probabilities without modifying the test.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts the configured LiveVariant deployment to retrieve current results.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads registry status and verified-domain information for a test without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts the configured LiveVariant deployment's account registry to read status.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists tests available to the signed-in account without creating or changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the current LiveVariant deployment's authenticated account context only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes an existing test into an organization's LiveVariant test list after validating the stats secret.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts the configured LiveVariant deployment to update its account registry.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores image bytes in the deployment's asset store and returns protected asset URLs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uploads image data to the configured LiveVariant deployment's asset endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: Uses content-addressed storage and does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns channel-specific variant-writing guidance without reading or changing server state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact external services or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Get constraints before drafting email image variants.
test_cases.user_prompt: I want to test three email hero images for a coffee newsletter. Give me the LiveVariant brief before we draft them.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns channel and format constraints, testing rules, hosting guidance, and the next step for building the test.

test_cases.description: Build a deterministic email image test from public asset URLs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Build a LiveVariant email image test named `review-email-hero` with two variants: control image `https://livevariant.com/icon-512.png` and variant image `https://livevariant.com/icon-512-dark.png`. Send clicks to `https://livevariant.com/`, use the EU region, and give me the ready-to-paste email image, click, and pixel links.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a test config, stats secret, manage URL, serve/click/pixel URLs, email-safe no-auto links, destination verification status or warnings, and concise usage instructions.

test_cases.description: Build a multi-slot website copy test.
test_cases.user_prompt: Build a LiveVariant website test named `review-site-copy` with two slots. The headline text variants are `Control: Adaptive A/B tests for email and web` and `Variant: Find the winning message while traffic flows`. The CTA text variants are `Control: Start a test` and `Variant: See win probabilities`. Use the EU region and explain that editing a variant later creates a new test.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a four-combination multi-slot test with slot names, encoded config, manage URL, SDK-oriented usage guidance, and any warnings.

test_cases.description: Inspect a supplied config and warm-start it with priors.
test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect this LiveVariant config and then add medium-confidence priors: control rate 0.04 and variant rate 0.06. Config: ``
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the decoded test structure and findings, then returns an updated encoded config with capped priors and an explanation of how much real traffic overrides the prior.

test_cases.description: Inspect a self-contained query-parameter test URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect this LiveVariant query-parameter email test URL and flag any setup issues: `https://livevariant.com/s?v=https%3A%2F%2Flivevariant.com%2Ficon-512.png&v=https%3A%2F%2Flivevariant.com%2Ficon-512-dark.png&vn=control&vn=variant&n=review-query-email&r=https%3A%2F%2Flivevariant.com%2F&id={{subscriber_id}}&auto=0`.
test_cases.expected_output: Decodes the query URL into a two-variant test, reports variant names, destination, region/context details when present, whether results are readable, and any lint findings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Put a reminder on my calendar to review the campaign next Friday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside LiveVariant's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated analytics reporting.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze this Google Analytics export and make a dashboard of traffic sources.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked unless the user asks to build, inspect, register, or read a LiveVariant test.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending an email campaign.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send my newsletter to the full customer list with subject line A for half and subject line B for half.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not send email or manage campaign delivery.
